hero.title: Your Harvest Deserves
hero.subtitle: Find trusted warehouses, connect with nearby farmers, and reduce your storage costs through shared group bookings.

howItWorks.title: How Krishi Vault Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Transforming empty warehouse slots into affordable, cooperative storage hubs in 4 simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Search nearby WDRA-certified warehouses with verified temperature control, pest management, and insurance coverage.
howItWorks.step2Title: Form or Join a Storage Group
howItWorks.step2Desc: Team up with neighboring farmers storing similar crops to book warehouse bays together at wholesale bulk rates.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Our algorithm automatically allocates rent proportionally based on exact metric tonnes or bags stored.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Store securely, monitor your inventory digitally, and retain crop value until mandi prices peak.

benefits.farmer1: Save up to 45% on monthly warehouse rent through collaborative group booking.
benefits.farmer2: Avoid distress sales right after harvest when market prices crash.
benefits.farmer3: Zero minimum booking barrier — even 2 MT can be booked seamlessly.
benefits.farmer4: Transparent live capacity tracking with verified facility security.
benefits.ownerTitle: Why Warehouse Owners Partner With Us
benefits.owner1: Achieve 95%+ year-round occupancy by filling partial and idle bays.
benefits.owner2: Guaranteed group aggregation without managing multiple small contracts.
benefits.owner3: Digital ledger for automated rental calculations and transparent farmer billing.
benefits.owner4: Direct reach to thousands of local farmer producer organizations (FPOs).
